exact_payload_rule: For each private revision fixture, the derived POST payload must exactly equal an independently reconstructed expected successful-control map. No extra or missing key is permitted.

common_rules.student_uid: canonical archive identity after edit-form UID equality is proven
common_rules.source_timestamp: revision source tutorial timestamp; the edit-form timestamp must equal the archive identity timestamp
common_rules.tutorial_type: validated edit-form tutorial type matching archive identity
common_rules.absent: summary/archive authority; true emits absent=on and false omits the key
common_rules.overall_level: validated edit-form semantic level serialized to canonical GEL spelling; unset emits the overall placeholder

transformations.aims: plain semantic text -> HTML escape -> newline to
transformations.final_reading: must always be present in a Final payload; unset emits canonical skill-level placeholder

historical_anomaly_rule: The historical edit checkbox may disagree with archive absent. Round-trip expectation uses archive absent and requires the discrepancy to remain provenance only.

mutation_isolation.rule: Changing one editable semantic value in an otherwise valid state may change only its declared GEL payload field; changing provenance-only fields must change no payload field.

network_rule: This phase grants no HTTP client, session, or GEL write authority. Round-trip/N2a serialization validation is offline only.

n2a_origin_rules.new_datetime: must be absent from payload; no datetime key may be emitted
n2a_origin_rules.new_teacher: must equal immutable New-form teacher authority carried by DraftOrigin::New
n2a_origin_rules.revision_teacher: must equal immutable historical teacher authority carried by DraftOrigin::Revision
n2a_origin_rules.identity: New has no authoritative created tutorial identity before future server readback
